SDG Target:
End poverty in all its forms
everywhere.
1.3 - Implement nationally appropriate
social protection systems and
measures for all, including floors, and
by 2030 achieve substantial coverage of
the poor and the vulnerable.
Result:
» 2.1 million beneficiaries (cumulative) reached with
social protection support (1.2 million in 2019).
» Shs 64 Billion cumulative disbursements issued
(Shs 2 Billion in 2019).

SDG Target:
End hunger, achieve food security
and improved nutrition, and promote
sustainable agriculture
2.3- By 2030, double the agricultural
productivity and incomes of small-scale
food producers.
2.4- By 2030, ensure sustainable food
production systems and implement
resilient agricultural practices.
Result:
» Shs 7.6 Billion disbursed through Value Chain
Agriculture Financing Model under Kilimo
Biashara loan product.
» 79,000 farmers financed.
» 40,000 smallholder farmers supported through
the Kenya Cereals Enhancement Program (in
partnership with IFAD).
» 33,127 small and medium scale farmers
supported to increase agriculture production
and incomes (in partnership with Embassy of the
Kingdom of Netherlands and Norwegian Agency
for Development (Norad).
» Provision of Weather and Index Based Livestock
Insurance to Farmers.
